          Flight arrivals at Mumbai Airport (BOM)

Mumbai Airport offers a wide range of passenger services to make your arrival in Mumbai pleasant and convenient.           Marvel at Mumbai: Discover the Soul of the City of Dreams

          Welcome to Mumbai, a high-energy metropolis where dreams come alive and history meets the future. Known as the City of Dreams, this vibrant coastal destination invites you to explore its bustling streets, grand colonial architecture, and deep cultural heritage. Feel the energetic pulse of local markets and take in the beautiful sunsets over the Arabian Sea. Your unforgettable urban adventure awaits in this spectacular Indian hub.


          1. Marvel At The Gateway Of India

          Admire this stunning architectural masterpiece where history seamlessly meets the Arabian Sea. Standing as a symbol of Mumbai's rich past, this iconic monument offers breathtaking waterfront views and serves as the perfect starting point for your city exploration.


          2. Stroll Along Marine Drive

          Take a scenic walk down the curving shoreline to experience panoramic coastal views and refreshing ocean breezes. Known affectionately as the Queen's Necklace, this vibrant promenade comes alive at night, offering a peaceful escape with glittering city lights.


          3. Cruise To Elephanta Caves

          Board a scenic ferry ride to discover ancient rock-cut art and archaeological wonders on a nearby island. These historic cave temples showcase magnificent rock carvings dedicated to regional heritage, making it an essential trip for history enthusiasts.


          4. Indulge In A Street Food Tour

          Savor vibrant local flavors like legendary snacks and fresh sweets across bustling night markets. Taste iconic dishes like Vada Pav and Pav Bhaji as you immerse yourself in the culinary traditions that define Mumbai's energetic food culture.


          5. Tour The Majestic Film City

          Go behind the scenes of the famous Bollywood entertainment industry to see where movie magic happens. Explore expansive sets, learn about the filmmaking process, and experience the creative spirit of one of the world's largest cinema hubs.

          The best time to book a flight to Mumbai is 3 - 6 months before your date of travel. This would give you the best chance of finding the best prices and timings that fit your schedule.
